method: Boolean subtraction of opposite-layer native filled GND plus GND pads/tracks/vias from full SPI track copper, arcs polygonized within 0.005 mm; exact missing polygon areas reported. Length summaries use <=0.1 mm longitudinal intervals, trace centre and both edges sampled; all SPI nets including Pico and source segments. Every via reported. Antipads included. No electromagnetic or impedance claim.
